clientConfigFields.label: Shop subdomain
clientConfigFields.description: The store-specific part before .myshopify.com, such as acme for acme.myshopify.com.

auth.label: Admin API access token
auth.description: Shopify Admin API access token sent with the X-Shopify-Access-Token header. Create or install a custom app and copy its Admin API access token.

extraFields.label: Shop domain
extraFields.description: The store's myshopify.com domain, such as acme.myshopify.com. A Shopify admin URL for the same shop is also accepted.

triggers.name: on_shop_event

triggerPermissions.name: Store Event
triggerPermissions.description: Creates and deletes shop webhooks and receives the configured store event topic.
triggerPermissions.instructions: The Admin API token must have the access scopes required by the selected webhook topic; protected customer data topics may require additional approval. Topic-specific permissions are checked by Shopify.
